story.name: Kể chuyện
story.rule: Open with one concrete everyday moment or observation that is easy to picture, then tie the product to it lightly. A short story, never a customer's story.

short.name: Ngắn gọn
short.rule: Two or three plain sentences: the product and one calm thought about how it sits in a home. No story.

sale.name: Bán hàng
sale.rule: Say clearly what the product is and give one reason to look at it, still warm and unhurried. No pressure, no discount, no scarcity.
